title: Manifest
description: FROZEN v1.0. One manifest.json per processed original, written by Stream 3 (pipeline) to data/derived/<asset_id>/manifest.json and ingested by Stream 2 (backend). Shape follows the approved design Page, section 5. All paths inside 'segments/frames/slides/derived_files' are relative to data/derived/<asset_id>/. The pipeline NEVER deletes or modifies the original.

schema_version.description: OUR RECOMMENDATION (not on the Page): lets the backend reject old manifests. Optional; default '1.0'.

segments.description: Timed transcript segments. Empty for documents.

frames.description: Kept key frames. Empty for documents.

slides.description: One entry per PDF page. Empty for videos.

derived_files.description: EVERY derived file kept on disk for this asset (transcript, each frame, each page image, optional audio), with its real measured size. manifest.json itself is NOT listed (it cannot contain its own size); the backend measures it at ingest. Temporary files (e.g. extracted WAV) are deleted by the pipeline and never listed. The storage report sums ONLY this list + manifest bytes, so frames[].bytes / slides[].bytes are informational and must not be added again.

PHash.description: Perceptual hash as lowercase hex. imagehash.phash(hash_size=8) => 16 hex chars (64 bits). See contracts/thresholds.json.

LocalId.description: Id unique only inside one asset: segments 's<n>', frames 'f<n>', slides 'p<page>'. Globally an item is '<asset_id>:<local_id>' (see ItemRef in api.schema.json).

path.description: Relative to the data/ directory, e.g. 'originals/a_01/deck.pdf'. Read-only.

AssetMetadata.description: Only fill what is really present in the file / file name. Never invent doc numbers or revisions (PDF p.3: metadata not guaranteed).

date.description: As found in the source (PDF metadata or text). ISO 8601 if parseable, else raw string.

language.description: Detected language code for videos (faster-whisper), e.g. 'en', 'sv'. null for documents unless detected.

duration_seconds.description: OUR RECOMMENDATION (not on the Page): video length. Optional.

frame_id.description: The kept frame on screen when this segment STARTS (frame.t_start <= start < frame.t_end).

speaker.description: Recording-local voice label (Speaker 1, Speaker 2, ...), or null when unavailable or uncertain.

t_end.description: Time of the next kept frame, or video end. Covers [t_start, t_end).

matched_slide.description: STRETCH (levels 3-4). Global slide ref '<asset_id>:p<page>' or null. Always null in P0.

slide.description: REC v1.1 (unique-slide pass): 1-based number of the unique slide shown in this time range. Several ranges can show the same slide (the talk went back to it); they then share one image file. Absent on manifests made before the pass.

source_frames.description: REC v1.1: ids of the originally extracted key frames merged into this time range (audit trail). The first one is this frame's id.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the NORMALISED page text (rule in CONTRACTS.md: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace, strip). The file SHA-256 is original.sha256; together with phash these are the three hashes.

model.description: e.g. 'faster-whisper small int8'; null for documents.

frame_threshold.description: pHash distance used to keep a new frame; null for documents.

warnings.description: OUR RECOMMENDATION (not on the Page): non-fatal issues, e.g. 'no text layer on page 3'. Optional.

unique_slides.description: REC v1.1: unique-slide pass result (videos); absent or null if it has not run.

UniqueSlidesInfo.description: REC v1.1: result of the unique-slide pass (one image per unique slide; near-identical repeats removed). Video only.

applied_as.description: 'pipeline' = during processing; 'post_pass' = later, on the already extracted frames (no re-transcription).

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of a post-pass; null when applied during processing.

run_count.description: Number of time ranges in frames[] after the pass.

overlay_mask.description: Ignored live-overlay area (e.g. webcam box) as [x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions of the picture, or null.
